official.tuition_coverage_note: E-JUST states the TICAD8 scholarship "is a fully funded scholarship that covers: Tuition fees, Accommodation, Monthly stipend, Medical care, International Flight Fare (Round Tickets; from and to the applicant's home country)".
benefits: International flight fare - round tickets from and to the applicant's home country
Six months of preparatory courses where necessary
eligibility: Applicants shall be researchers or instructors (or potentially expected to become those) who need to obtain their M.Sc. degree in the fields of Science or Engineering or another specialization
Applicant must be a holder of the nationality of a country in Africa except for Egypt
Applicant must have a current home address in an African country
Applicant must not be serving in the military
Applicants should fulfill all the admission requirements and pass the academic interview and oral examination

Applicants who shall continue their jobs in their home universities or institutions after completion of their postgraduate programme at E-JUST are preferable; in this case, endorsement of the application forms by their home institution is required to assure that they would return to home institutions in the future
requirements: M.Sc. applicants must hold a bachelor's degree in the field of specialisation with CGPA at least 3 out of 4, description at least very good, or classification at least second class upper or equivalent (faculty-specific academic background tables apply)
Full-time students: TOEFL iBT minimum 79 or Academic IELTS minimum 6.5; the language certificate must be valid at the time of application submission

Provisionally accepted students: Duolingo English Test minimum 125, TOEFL iBT minimum 65 or Academic IELTS minimum 5.5, with a mandatory English language course in the preparatory year and the full-time threshold to be met within one academic year of enrolment or enrolment is terminated
Applicants must pass the personal and academic interview (minimum acceptance percentage 60%) and the oral examination

Equivalency certificate from the Egyptian Supreme Council of Universities and security clearance from the Ministry of Interior Affairs - E-JUST applies on behalf of applicants who pass the interview and oral examination, but failing to acquire either leads to termination of the application
Scholarships are full-time; E-JUST students must devote themselves fully to study and research and are not allowed to work elsewhere during the scholarship period
documents: Research proposal about the research area chosen from the application form
Statement of purpose stating reasons for joining E-JUST
B.Sc. certificate and B.Sc. transcript, with the transcript showing the grading system and scanned front and back
Two academic recommendation letters from professors or ex-advisors in the applicant's affiliating university or academic institution
Personal data passport page (valid for at least two years from the date of application) and a formal personal photograph
Certificate of health and security application on E-JUST designated forms
Endorsement letter, signed and stamped by the affiliated institution, for applicants currently working as teaching or research assistants
selection_criteria: The student's academic background must match the academic requirements of the programme applied for, per the published academic background tables
Applicants must pass the academic interview and oral examination
Reasons for disqualification at any stage of the selection procedure will not be disclosed, and the schedule is subject to change
Support is conditional on the student's good standing with the E-JUST graduate programme; an evaluation progress report is sent semi-annually to the sponsor
coverage: International round-trip flight fare between the applicant's home country and Egypt
application_method: Click "Apply now" through the international admission tab on the E-JUST website, fill in the online application and attach all required documents
Sit the admission interview and oral examination as scheduled by E-JUST
official.application_route: Online application through the international admission tab on the E-JUST website, with all documents attached
official.study_mode: Full time only; scholarship holders must devote themselves fully to study and research and are not allowed to work elsewhere during the scholarship period
official.citizenship_residency: Nationality of a country in Africa except Egypt, with a current home address in an African country
official.international_eligibility: Open to nationals of African countries other than Egypt
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: M.Sc. programmes in Engineering, Computer Science and Information Technology, Basic and Applied Sciences, International Business and Humanities, and Heritage Science; the academic background must match the programme's tables
official.research_requirement: Applicants must attach a research proposal about the research area chosen from the application form
official.duration: The period necessary to complete the degree requirements in E-JUST - two years for the M.Sc. degree in addition to six months of preparatory courses if necessary
official.description: E-JUST offers the E-JUST TICAD8 African Scholarships for STI to develop high quality human resources in the field of science, technology and innovation toward a future African STI network and beyond, provided under the cooperation of the Egyptian government and JICA; the fully funded award covers tuition fees, accommodation, a monthly stipend, medical care and international round-trip airfare for M.Sc. study.
official.program_type: Government-funded full scholarship for African nationals, delivered by a national university
official.english_requirement: Full-time students: TOEFL iBT minimum 79 or Academic IELTS minimum 6.5, valid at application. Provisionally accepted students: Duolingo English Test minimum 125, TOEFL iBT minimum 65 or Academic IELTS minimum 5.5, with a mandatory English language course in the preparatory year. Applicants whose native language is English, from countries where English is an official language, are exempt.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a staff-development award as much as a scholarship: preference goes to researchers and instructors who will return to a home institution, and that return must be endorsed in a signed and stamped letter attached to the application. The English route is unusually forgiving - provisional acceptance at IELTS 5.5, TOEFL 65 or Duolingo 125 is possible with a compulsory preparatory English course - so a borderline score need not stop you, but the equivalency certificate and security clearance can end an application after you have already passed the interview.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Academic staff and early-career researchers at African (non-Egyptian) institutions who need an M.Sc. in engineering, computing, sciences, business and humanities, or heritage science, and who will return to their home institution.
application_readiness_checklist: Secure the endorsement letter from your home institution early - it must be signed and stamped and must state you will return after the programme
Check your bachelor's degree against the chosen programme's academic background table before selecting a department
Book an English test that will still be valid at submission; otherwise plan for the provisional route with its preparatory course
Prepare the research proposal around the specific research area chosen on the application form
Scan the B.Sc. transcript front and back so the grading system is legible, and request your university handbook extract showing registration and certificate conditions
common_rejection_risks: Holding Egyptian nationality or lacking a current home address in an African country, both exclusionary
Serving in the military, which disqualifies outright
An academic background that does not match the programme's published background tables
Failing to obtain the equivalency certificate or security clearance after passing the interview, which terminates the application
Planning to work while enrolled - the scholarship is full-time only
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: E-JUST states that any costs incurred during the selection procedures - including travel expenses, document preparation (official papers, photos, visa application) and other personal expenses - will not be covered and must be paid by the applicant.
document_audit: Originals certified by the Egyptian embassy must follow after the interview; in the Fall 2026 calendar the deadline for them was 31 May 2026
The endorsement letter is mandatory for applicants currently working as teaching or research assistants
All credentials must be in English or accompanied by an official translation, and original documents submitted are never returned
alerts: Reasons for disqualification are never disclosed, so a silent rejection leaves nothing to appeal
The schedule is explicitly subject to change, so build slack around interview, examination and travel dates
Progress is reviewed semi-annually and reported to the sponsor, so grades stay under continuous scrutiny
The next cycle's dates are not yet published - the Fall 2026 calendar shows submissions close around mid-February, so prepare by early winter
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply online via the international admission tab with the endorsed form and full document set, pass the interview and oral examination, then let E-JUST obtain the equivalency certificate and security clearance on your behalf.
